import gc
import warnings
import trio
async def main():
    import trio.socket as tsocket
    s = tsocket.socket(type=tsocket.SOCK_DGRAM)
    await s.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
    ep = trio.DTLSEndpoint(s)
    assert not ep._closed
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as rec:
        warnings.simplefilter('always')
        del ep
        gc.collect()
        await trio.sleep(0.1)
    msgs = [str(w.message) for w in rec if issubclass(w.category, ResourceWarning)]
    assert any('unclosed DTLS endpoint' in m for m in msgs), 'finalizer must warn on unclosed release'
    print('warned_unclosed')
    s2 = tsocket.socket(type=tsocket.SOCK_DGRAM)
    await s2.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
    ep2 = trio.DTLSEndpoint(s2)
    ep2.close()
    assert ep2._closed
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as rec2:
        warnings.simplefilter('always')
        del ep2
        gc.collect()
        await trio.sleep(0.1)
    msgs2 = [str(w.message) for w in rec2 if issubclass(w.category, ResourceWarning) and 'DTLS endpoint' in str(w.message)]
    assert not msgs2, msgs2
    print('closed_silent_ok')
trio.run(main)
